descriptions.text: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 3 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the complimentary shuttle.

Enjoy Middle Eastern cuisine at Al Khaima, one of the hotel's 7 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 11 coffee shops/cafes. When you are in need of a refreshing drink, visit the beach bar or one of 4 bars/lounges, or 2 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 2045 square feet (190 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 4 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

Make yourself at home in one of the 508 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, while DVD players and satellite programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

activities.activityName: Dubai Sky Views Observatory Ticket with Free Glass Slide + Photos
activities.description: Discover the Dubai Sky Views Observatory with its thrilling Glass Slide, a must-visit attraction offering a unique and exhilarating experience in the heart of Dubai. Located atop the Address Sky View Hotel, this tour combines the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk for an unforgettable adventure. With your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, you gain access to the Observatory, boasting mesmerizing views of Dubai, and the Sky Slide, a thrilling descent through a transparent glass tube from the 53rd to the 52nd level. Take in panoramic views of iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Sheikh Zayed Road as you capture stunning photos on the 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the twin hotel towers. Don't miss the chance to ride the first-of-its-kind Glass Slide for an adrenaline rush like no other. Book your Dubai Sky Views tour today and prepare to be captivated by the city's breathtaking vistas and unmatched thrills.

inclusions.otherDescription: Get the most compelling views over Dubai’s skyline and beyond as you zoom up 219.5 meters high
Sky Views Dubai Entry Ticket

itineraryItems.description:
The Dubai Sky Views tour is an absolute must-visit. Sky Views from Emaar, which is perched atop the Address Sky View Hotel, combines three thrilling activities—the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk—into one. The Observatory, which offers the most mesmerizing views of Dubai, is included in your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, as is access to the Sky Slide, which whisks you down from the 53rd level to the 52nd level through a completely transparent glass tube while ensuring the most fantastical views of the surroundings.
Take Pictures:

A 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the towers of this twin hotel, which is located at a height of 219.5 meters, is the main attraction of the Observatory's two levels. It offers a fantastic vantage point from which to take in the magnificent cityscapes as well as an excellent location for taking photos that are ideal for your Social Platforms like Instagram and etc. 

Take a Ride on the First-of-a-Kind Glass Slide.

Burj Al Arab is touted to be the most luxurious hotel in the world and dining experience at Burj Al Arab is class apart given its best in class food, ambience, and the lovely decor. 

The 90-minute butler-guided tour will take guests on an exclusive journey of discovery, to hear the untold stories of Dubai’s world-famous hotel and uncover what makes the international icon of the UAE a landmark of architectural innovation. activities.description:
Experience the pinnacle of cultural sophistication with our exclusive Louvre Museum Tour, complete with private transfer for a seamless and luxurious journey.

Embark on a captivating exploration of the Louvre Abu Dhabi, a stunning architectural masterpiece and cultural treasure trove nestled on Saadiyat Island. With your private transfer whisking you away from your accommodation, you'll arrive in style and comfort, ready to immerse yourself in the world of art and history.

As you step inside the museum, you'll be greeted by the mesmerizing dome, a work of art in itself, designed to create a harmonious interplay of light and shadow. With your knowledgeable guide leading the way, you'll embark on a curated journey through the museum's vast collection, spanning ancient civilizations to contemporary masterpieces.

itineraryItems.description:
Discover the Louvre Abu Dhabi, an architectural marvel and cultural treasure trove nestled on Saadiyat Island in the United Arab Emirates. This awe-inspiring museum is an emblem of artistic excellence and cross-cultural dialogue, showcasing a vast collection of masterpieces spanning millennia and continents. Designed by the esteemed architect Jean Nouvel, the museum's mesmerizing dome, inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, creates a captivating interplay of light and shadow.

As you step inside, you'll embark on a journey through time and space, encountering artworks from ancient civilizations to modern-day masterpieces. Explore galleries filled with priceless artifacts, paintings, sculptures, and decorative arts, carefully curated to highlight the interconnectedness of human creativity across cultures and civilizations.

activities.description: Qasr Al Watan is one of the newest attractions in the majestic country of UAE. This monument stands unique due to the opportunity it offers to its visitors in terms of experience, learning, and heritage discovery. Qasr Al Watan is much more than a palace. It is a journey through a contemporary setup that takes you through the countries’ rich past and legendary rulers that have been an integral part of the nation’s journey. A trip to Qasr Al Watan is going to change the way you see and understand the United Arab Emirates and help you gain a deeper sense of appreciation.

inclusions.otherDescription: Access to the Qasr Al Watan Palace

packageDetails.title: Qasr Al Watan Abu Dhabi Entry Ticket

itineraryItems.description:
Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, is home to some of the most beautiful monuments and buildings in the country. The latest addition to the city is the Qasr Al Watan. The presidential palace is also known as the newest cultural landmark of the Emirate city. Qasr Al Watan houses the offices of the President, Vice President, and Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi.

Qasr Al Watan is the epitome of beauty, grace, and marvelous architecture. You would get to visit the beautiful rooms of the palace including the library, the Great Hall, the Barza (the royal banquet), etc. You would also be able to attend interactive cultural exhibitions, view rare manuscripts and artifacts, and witness the contribution of Arabs in the fields of humanities, science, literature, and arts. The ticket also gives you the chance to explore the gorgeous gardens that flank the palace.
itineraryItems.name: Qasr Al Watan

activities.description:
Yas Island in Abu Dhabi is a popular spot for thrill seekers. It now also caters to families with the addition of KidZania Abu Dhabi. This 60,000 sq. ft. facility is located in Yas Mall, adjacent to attractions like Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld, and Warner Bros. KidZania Abu Dhabi is the second KidZania location in the UAE, following the Dubai Mall.

KidZania is a theme park for kids aged 4 to 16 that offers real-life occupations and learning experiences with entertainment.

KidZania Abu Dhabi offers over 60 role-playing activities for kids, allowing them to experience their favorite professions in a miniature city. Kids can earn and spend KidZos, the park's currency, while enjoying their financial independence.

While parents or adults aren't allowed inside the facility, electronic wristbands connect them with their children and trained supervisors are available to help kids navigate the miniature city.

inclusions.otherDescription: A chance for children to develop social skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities.
Immersive learning and hands-on engagement in various professions and occupations.
admission to KidZania Abu Dhabi's interactive theme park.
Opportunity to participate in over 80 role-playing activities and experiences.

exclusions.otherDescription: All personal expenses spend for shopping, drinks and dining etc on-site during the tour.

itineraryItems.description:
KidZania Abu Dhabi is an impressive and stimulating theme park located in the vibrant Yas Island. Its primary goal is to offer children an immersive learning experience through a wide range of interactive activities. With over 80 role-playing games, kids have the opportunity to explore various professions, such as pilot, shopkeeper, astronaut, doctor, nurse, firefighter, and truck driver, among others. 

This innovative mini city allows children to gain valuable insights into the real world while having fun. They can learn about different professions and how they function, enhancing their social skills, problem-solving abilities, and creativity. The park is designed to cater to children aged between 4 to 16 years, with activities tailored to suit different age groups. 

At KidZania Abu Dhabi, parents can relax at the lounge while their kids engage in fun and educational activities. The park's staff ensures the safety and well-being of every child.
itineraryItems.name: KidZania Abu Dhabi
